input.question: Who was the head of government of Nădrag?

documents.text:
Title: The Unlikely Leader of Nădrag: The Story of Liviu Muntean

In the heart of Timiș County, Romania, lies the picturesque commune of Nădrag, a place where tradition and innovation blend seamlessly. It is here that Liviu Muntean, a Romanian politician from Sibiu County, made his mark as the head of government, leaving an indelible imprint on the community. The year was 2004, and Nădrag was facing a critical juncture. The once-thriving agricultural sector was struggling, and the local economy was in dire need of revitalization. It was against this backdrop that Liviu Muntean, a charismatic leader with a vision for progress, emerged as the beacon of hope for the people of Nădrag. Muntean's journey to the top began with his grassroots involvement in local politics. As a member of the Romanian Democratic Party, he had built a reputation as a passionate advocate for rural development and social welfare. His dedication to the cause earned him the respect and admiration of the Nădrag community, who saw in him a leader capable of driving meaningful change. In 2004, Muntean's party nominated him as their candidate for the position of commune mayor. The election campaign was intense, with Muntean facing stiff competition from established politicians. However, his message of hope and renewal resonated deeply with the people of Nădrag, who were desperate for a fresh start. On election day, the people of Nădrag spoke loudly, electing Liviu Muntean as their new mayor with a landslide victory. The margin of victory was staggering, with Muntean securing over 70% of the votes. This overwhelming mandate was a testament to the trust the community had placed in him, and he was determined to justify their faith. As the head of government, Muntean set out to revitalize Nădrag's economy. He launched a series of initiatives aimed at promoting sustainable agriculture, supporting local businesses, and creating jobs. His administration invested heavily in infrastructure development, building new roads, schools, and healthcare facilities. These efforts paid off, as Nădrag began to flourish once more. One of Muntean's most notable achievements was the establishment of the Nădrag Agricultural Cooperative. This innovative project brought together local farmers, providing them with access to modern technology, training, and market opportunities.
